guideScope: Curated verified-source notes; incomplete coverage. Not a replacement for live journal sync or GPS.
sourcePolicy: Original concise paraphrases and locations. Never reproduce game lore text wholesale. Source links retained. Per-user completion is manual, local to browser.

quests.title: A Glimpse Of Eternity
quests.scope: Enshrouded 1.0 source-backed guide; travel directions are not live GPS
quests.summary: Follow a wizard's five connected journal entries through concealed tombs. The lore clues actually identify the next area, but the entrances can be unmarked.
requirements: Official wiki lists prerequisite Obtaining A Mill, placing the Mill, Flame Altar Level 8; check your current game journal

steps.heading: Find first hidden tomb
steps.direction: At the marked hidden tomb, clear rubble within the short-pillared ruins; enter underground, take the southern watery passage and reach the lectern.
steps.completion: Read Experiments Of Eternity at the lectern.

steps.heading: Follow the Darkwater jungle clue
steps.direction: Next tomb is an unmarked ruined building across Gateway Outpost Darkwater, near the jungle. Wiki reference coordinates X 5584, Y 4760 (legacy frame only). Dig into the western interior.
steps.location: Tomb near Darkwater, Veilwater Basin / jungle
steps.completion: Read Ashes Of Eternity and recover the fireball spell from the submerged sarcophagus.

steps.heading: Search behind the lake tower
steps.direction: Find the ruin hidden in rock near Goldrock Saddle, behind the great tower in the lake. Wiki reference X 5040, Y 5905 (legacy frame). Descend to the water-filled lectern chamber.
steps.completion: Read The Spell That Betrayed Me and collect the heal-beam spell.

steps.heading: Find the maze tomb by the Mining Rift
steps.direction: The next burial tunnel is near Mining Rift heading toward Blackmire. Wiki marks two unverified 1.0 reference entrances: X 3780 Y 6520 or X 3683 Y 6378. The second end has a nearby grave.
steps.completion: Read Fast As Lightning; inspect and dig the grave by the alternate entrance for the lightning spell.

steps.heading: Last tomb near Stillwater Bay
steps.direction: Look near the foot of the hills beyond Stillwater Bay. Wiki reference X 3208, Y 7287; not calibrated to 1.0 in-game coordinates. Clear enemies, read the lectern, then investigate submerged sarcophagus.
steps.completion: Read Frozen Eternity and retrieve the ice spell.

steps.heading: Return to the Alchemist
steps.direction: Return home and speak with the Alchemist after collecting the tomb findings.
steps.completion: Talk to the Alchemist to finish the quest.

clues.foundAt: First hidden tomb, underground lectern past southern water area
clues.whatItMeans: The wizard is moving across Gateway Outpost Darkwater into dense jungle to continue experiments.
clues.nextAction: Use the Darkwater outpost as the next area landmark and look for a ruin that is not automatically marked.
clues.easyToMiss: You must read the page to advance; searching only the visible map marker can send you in circles.

clues.foundAt: Second tomb: lectern after digging down through a ruined building
clues.whatItMeans: The next tomb is hidden close to Goldrock Saddle behind the large tower in the lake.
clues.nextAction: Locate the rocky arching ruin near the lake and descend into the tomb.
clues.easyToMiss: Do not confuse the lore note's position with the unmarked tomb entrance.

clues.foundAt: Third tomb, lectern close to the water-filled chamber
clues.whatItMeans: The wizard went to a maze-like tomb near the Mining Rift on the route toward Blackmire.
clues.nextAction: Search the Mining Rift passage and account for separate tunnel entrances.
clues.easyToMiss: The actual spell pickup is in the water, not simply the lore book.

clues.foundAt: Fourth area by the tomb exit and grave near Blackmire
clues.whatItMeans: The final test took place at a hidden tomb near Stillwater Bay, close to the base of the hills.
clues.nextAction: Search the Stillwater Bay foothills for the last lectern.
clues.easyToMiss: Inspect the nearby grave for the lightning spell; don't assume you must swim the full tunnel.

clues.foundAt: Fifth tomb lectern, beyond Hollow enemies
clues.whatItMeans: The wizard believed freezing himself might preserve his life. The journal trail ends here.
clues.nextAction: Recover the ice spell from the underwater sarcophagus and return to the Alchemist.
clues.easyToMiss: Reading the book and finding the sarcophagus are distinct actions.

dataWarnings: Any listed X/Y pairs originate from the wiki's own coordinate context; they are not calibrated world graph coordinates or verified Enshrouded 1.0 GPS positions.
The source guide is detailed but full route traversal and exact spell names/rewards should be checked against the game build.

quests.title: The Hunter's Hand Spindle — Explore Westcott
quests.summary: The map sends you to search Westcott, but the required diary is inside a particular damaged two-story stone house.
requirements: Talk to the Hunter about the lost spindle after prior Hunter progression
Check Shroud resistance before entering the valley on the suggested route

steps.heading: Approach Westcott
steps.direction: A reported route starts at the Springlands Ancient Spire, glides northwest, passes the Elixir Well ruins and exits the Shroud up rocky slopes toward Westcott.
steps.completion: Reach Westcott; the game changes to a search-area objective.

steps.heading: Find the damaged stone house
steps.direction: Look for the two-story stone building near Westcott's entry side, recognizable by its blown-open roof. Enter and break the internal wooden barricades.

steps.heading: Read the required diary
steps.direction: On the upper terrace, read the glowing red diary scroll on the wooden table. There is a second diary entry below in the kitchen.
steps.completion: First diary entry advances the objective; the game points toward Athalan Skree's trail.

steps.heading: Follow up at the hunter's camp
steps.direction: Search the abandoned hunter's camp north-northwest of Westcott and read the note there to continue the Hand Spindle trail.
steps.completion: Continue toward the spindle using the new objective.

clues.entry: Martha's Diary — First Entry of Midyear, 503 D.A.
clues.foundAt: Open upper floor / terrace of the two-story stone house near Westcott's entrance, on a wooden table
clues.whatItMeans: Reading the diary is the real search objective and reveals the next lead in the Hunter's trail.
clues.nextAction: Continue the quest toward the abandoned hunter camp north-northwest of town.
clues.easyToMiss: The quest marker is a broad search area; the required scroll is upstairs behind breakable internal barricades.

clues.foundAt: Kitchen on the first floor of the same house
clues.whatItMeans: Additional story context; the guide indicates this one is not required to clear the Westcott search objective.
clues.nextAction: Read it for lore if desired, then make sure the upstairs first diary was read.
clues.easyToMiss: The downstairs note can be mistaken for the objective note.

clues.foundAt: Abandoned camp to the north-northwest of Westcott
clues.whatItMeans: Progresses the trail toward retrieving the Hand Spindle.
clues.nextAction: Read the camp note before searching farther.
clues.easyToMiss: The camp is less conspicuous than large marked ruins. Exact note title needs in-game verification.

dataWarnings: Route is practical guidance, not a verified graph or live tracking.
Exact camp note title and final spindle pickup need direct game verification.

quests.title: Vukah Rituals Uncovered
quests.summary: The objective lies below Fort Kelvin's cliffs; collect a ritual dagger and a newspaper clipping, then report back.
requirements: Recruit Marianne Reed and have her settled at base

steps.heading: Find the pit below Fort Kelvin
steps.direction: Head to the foot of Fort Kelvin's cliffs and search for Sacrificial Vukah Pit. The objective isn't at the top of the fortress.
steps.location: Sacrificial Vukah Pit, below Fort Kelvin
steps.completion: Enter pit until the location-reached notice appears.

steps.heading: Collect the dagger and newspaper
steps.direction: Search the pit for the Sacrificial Vukah Dagger and Ramone Jones's writing; both are worth collecting on the same visit.
steps.completion: Collect the dagger and newspaper clipping.

steps.heading: Report to Marianne
steps.direction: Return to the home base, talk to Marianne Reed and report the findings.

clues.foundAt: Sacrificial Vukah Pit at the base of Fort Kelvin cliffs
clues.whatItMeans: Clipping points toward Ramone's separate investigation and triggers the Ramone's Writing follow-up.
clues.nextAction: After reporting to Marianne, search for Ramone's hiding place in a concealed cellar below a house at Shanty Shacks.
clues.easyToMiss: The pit is at cliff level BELOW the fort; the clipping matters separately from the dagger.

clues.foundAt: Journal entry when Vukah Rituals Uncovered is assigned
clues.whatItMeans: References residents being pushed from the Fort Kelvin cliffs; the destination is the sacrificial pit down below, not the fort's upper rooms.
clues.nextAction: Find a safe descent to the bottom of the cliffs.
clues.easyToMiss: The map marker can feel vertically ambiguous.

dataWarnings: The guide documents a route and journal lead, not a game API or coordinates.
